description.narrative: The project is implemented in Bekaa in WN Chrouta center. The initial project period was from January to June 2025, but the project will be extended till end of December 2025. The project objective is to enhance women and girls' employability and educational opportunities through training sessions designed to meet the evolving demands of the job market. They are receiving comprehensive English language training to improve communication skills,ICDL training to equip them with digital literacy.They are also supported with PSS through protection in the same safe space helping participants manage stress & build self-confidence. In the extension phase, the project will introduce a more structured & participatory approach:English Language Training will be expanded to three learning levels: Survival English, Social English, and Confident Communication, using interactive handouts, videos, and daily practice through WhatsApp support groups.Digital Literacy Training is similarly structured into Basic Computer Literacy, Internet Tools, and Smart AI Use, with a special focus on mobile-accessible self-learning, practical applications, and emerging technologies such as Canva, voice typing, and AI tools for learning and job search.The Hygiene Material Production Course continues will focus on entrepreneurship by incorporating basic financial literacy from a curriculum developed by WND with the help of a specialist, covering pricing, budgeting, and marketing essentials. Final products are showcased in a public exhibition and gifted to attendees to promote participants’ work and expand their networks. A pilot peer-learning model is introduced, encouraging cross-course collaboration between participants of the English and Digital Literacy courses. Through the mentorship support, trainers will apply the skills gained during their own training to support participants and to sustain impact, encourage continued growth, and strengthen participants’ confidence as they pursue their goals.
